field.name: project_id
field.label: COM_JOOMLEAGUE_SITE_PROJECT_ID
field.query: SELECT id, name FROM #__joomleague_project ORDER BY name

field.name: round_id
field.label: COM_JOOMLEAGUE_SITE_ROUND
field.query: SELECT r.id, CONCAT(r.name, ' (', p.name, ')') AS name FROM #__joomleague_round AS r INNER JOIN #__joomleague_project AS p ON p.id = r.project_id ORDER BY p.name, r.roundcode
